en: A Song of Ascents. By David.

zh: 上帝是他子民的保護者

ja: 都上りの歌。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

ja: でなかったなら、 今、イスラエルは言え。
en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
u.src: 1  If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

p.src: 2  if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

en: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
u.src: 2  if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

p.src: 3  then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

ja: んでいただろう。 彼らの怒りが私たちに向かって燃え上がったとき。
en: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
u.src: 3  then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

p.src: 4  then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

en: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
u.src: 4  then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

p.src: 5  Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

en: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
u.src: 5  Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

p.src: 6  Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

ja: 主がほめたたえられますように。
en: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
u.src: 6  Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

p.src: 7  Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

en: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
u.src: 7  Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

p.src: 8  Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

ja: にある。 天と地を造られた方の御名に。
en: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
u.src: 8  Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
